item.tib: theg chen lam gyi rtsa ba dam pa gsum gyi khrid yig legs bshad bdud rtsi'i char sprin
item.coloph: ces dge sbyor gyi sbyor dngos rjes gsum du 'brel ba'i dam pa gsum gyi bshad khrid 'di ni rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po rigs kyi khu bo bla ma dam pa mdo rgyud grags pa'i zhal snga nas de ltar 'bri bar 'os pa'i bka' brtsal lhu ru blangs zhing / nye char dpal sprul bsod nams bstan rgyal dang a mdo nas byung ba'i bla ma dam pa g.yung drung nyi ma zung nas par rko ba'i thugs rtsol btsos nan bskul ngor/ snyigs dus kyi 'dren pa grub dbang yab sras kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa'i bon smra ba'i btsun pa bya bral ba khod spungs dbra ston pa ngag dbang bskal (skal) bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes ming du 'bod pa des rang gnas dbra khyung sA la'i ljongs kyi sgrub sde byang chub gling gi nags khrod nyams dga' ba'i gnas su gzhung mang po 'chad nyan gyi skabs rnams su rim par bris te/ slar yang zhus dag dang bcas legs par sbyar ba'o//
